$description: Tabs design preview tokens (stage 1). Decided by the Design System Lead on 2026-11-19: a row of Tab (B157), left-aligned, each tab as wide as its label, space.4 between tabs; a line border-width.1 in color.border.subtle under the whole row (the selection line of the selected tab sits on it); horizontal scroll when the tabs do not fit (no button, scrollbar hidden); the panel of the selected tab under the row, space.24 below the row, no padding, always focusable (focus ring color.border.focus). On color.background.page or color.background.surface. The look of each tab belongs to Tab. 'surface' is the context background.

surface.description: Context: background Tabs sits on (page or surface)

line-width.description: Thickness of the line under the row

panel-gap.description: Space between the row and the panel
